name: publicrecords
description: Agent Skills plus a hosted Apify MCP server for official public data: US federal contracts and grants, UK and EU tenders, city council meetings, ATS job postings, company social links, Etsy market research, competitor Google ads, sports odds, tennis scores, Spotify play counts, forecast track records, PDF and web-page to Markdown, audio transcription, and email domain/MX/disposable checks (not the mailbox), website tech-stack detection, phone number validation (not a live carrier lookup), Wikipedia/ECB FX/Treasury lookup, Crossref paper and DOI search, and bulk DNS / SPF / DMARC lookup. Authenticate with your own Apify account (OAuth or an API token). This plugin does not bundle tokens.
